newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle to assume 100 pct of Korea unit.
newsitem.headline: Nestle to assume 100 pct of Korea unit.

text.p: Swiss food and beverage conglomerate Nestle SA said it would spend about $30 million to raise its ownership in Nestle Korea Ltd. to 100 percent from 82 percent.
Nestle said in a statement that it had reached such an agreement with the Doosan Group of Seoul and the relevant companies. The deal is subject to regulatory approval.
Nestle said its Korean unit employs 730 people and produces and markets a wide range of coffee products, non-diary creamer, infant cereals and chocolate drinks.
It operates one factory in Cheong Yu, about 100 kilometres south-east of Seoul.
